title: ITER fusion assembly
summary: The international tokamak under assembly in southern France.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

ITER is a 35-nation project to build a tokamak designed to demonstrate tenfold energy gain, with first plasma targeted in the mid-2030s after repeated schedule slips. Its value is component qualification and physics data at burning-plasma scale, not electricity production. Cost overruns have made it a cautionary tale as well as a research asset.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Basic research
Estimated window 2034–2040
Confidence label Speculative
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

ITER is a public-good research programme; private fusion companies are racing to be irrelevant to it.

What Would Change The View

  • Assembly milestones and first plasma date.
  • Magnet and vacuum vessel commissioning.
  • Member-state funding continuity.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
